episodes.title: Amazing Fantasy
episodes.summary: During high school orientation Peter's life is forever changed. A new era of Spider-Man begins here!

episodes.title: The Parker Luck
episodes.summary: Peter begins an exclusive internship, but his first day is way more complicated than he expected.

episodes.title: Secret Identity Crisis
episodes.summary: Peter deals with the fallout of his secret revealed. Meanwhile, Lonnie's perfect life falls apart.

episodes.title: Hitting the Big Time
episodes.summary: Peter and Norman work through creative differences, while Lonnie undergoes a loyalty test.

episodes.title: The Unicorn Unleashed
episodes.summary: Peter makes a new friend. Meanwhile, Lonnie finds himself in the sights of a dangerous gang.

episodes.title: Duel with the Devil
episodes.summary: Peter's night off is derailed when he must suit up to stop a mysterious intruder.

episodes.title: Scorpion Rising
episodes.summary: Peter and Lonnie face the consequences of their secret lives. Spider-Man faces his biggest threat.

episodes.title: Tangled Web
episodes.summary: Norman gives Spider-Man an ultimatum, causing Peter to do some soul-searching.

episodes.title: Hero or Menace
episodes.summary: Spider-Man swings into action, as Lonnie looks to settle a score and Norman visits an old friend.

episodes.title: If This Be My Destiny...
episodes.summary: Peter's internship takes a dark turn with the arrival of an unexpected visitor.
